_meta.description: Bucket-level AGG_ZSCORE on customers.pulse income grouped by region — each region's z-score is computed against the cohort-wide mean / stddev so the per-region buckets emit standardised aggregates suitable for cross-region comparison. Distinct from ATTR_ZSCORE (per-row standardisation): AGG_ZSCORE folds the per-group means into the cohort population summary before standardising. Buffered.
_meta.name: zscore_grouped
